description: This file contains Dart data transfer objects (DTOs) used for modeling authentication tokens, API errors, credentials, eKYC status, sharing info, and utility functions, typically within a security or credential management system.

classes.name: AuthTokens
classes.description: Represents authentication tokens including access and refresh tokens.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: Models an API error with status code and message, implementing Exception.

classes.name: CredentialSummary
classes.description: Summarizes a credential with id, name, type, and creation date.

classes.name: CredentialDetail
classes.description: Extends CredentialSummary to include detailed claims for a credential.

classes.name: EKYCStatus
classes.description: Represents the status of an electronic KYC process, with status and optional reason.

classes.name: ShareInfo
classes.description: Models sharing information including id, token, creation time, and active status.

methods.name: AuthTokens.fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an AuthTokens object from a JSON map.

methods.name: ApiError.toString
methods.description: Overrides string representation for ApiError objects.

methods.name: CredentialSummary.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a CredentialSummary object from JSON data.

methods.name: CredentialDetail.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a CredentialDetail object from JSON data, including claims.

methods.name: EKYCStatus.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an EKYCStatus object from JSON data.

methods.name: ShareInfo.fromJson
methods.description: Builds a ShareInfo object from JSON data.

methods.name: prettyJson
methods.description: Returns indented JSON string for given data or fallback to string representation.
